frame_budget.note: 28 new frames for 38 set-ups. Every close a beat needs that has no same-state close earlier in the episode is generated (D-023 rule 4.8). The 10 second framings each reuse an approved frame of this episode: closes from closes (s16, s18 of s08; s17, s34 of s25; s19 of s14; s23 of s07; s24 of s20), a two-shot from a two-shot (s15 of s21), an insert from an insert (s30 of s11) and the boys from the lane wide (s28 of s26). All custom moves stay at scale 1.3 or less (D-010). Retakes under D-023 rule 4.1 are retakes, not new frames.

estimated_seconds.basis: Measured duration_s of each line's final take (voice/review.json and manifest; take 2 for hi l07, hi l17, en l07, en l22, take 1 elsewhere), plus the script's beat silences (16.4 s), plus 0.25 s after each of the 29 lines (7.25 s), plus one added 0.6 s hold on s33 before l29. Speech: hi 99.76 s, en 99.52 s. Shot durations use the longer language shot by shot (duration_s); duration_hi_s and duration_en_s are what each cut gets when its timeline is rebuilt from its own clips (D-014 rule 6). Split lines: l28 hi at the measured 0.24 s breath (2.76-3.00 s, cut at 2.88), en at an estimated 2.23 s (no pause after 'Don't lie to me.'); l29 at the measured pause (hi 0.95 s, en 1.16 s).
estimated_seconds.clarity_remap_D025: 2026-11-26, S7 Storyboard artist, clarity remap (D-025 item 8): totals re-summed from the shots after the remap. Shots that gained lines or changed split are timed from the clarity takes (voice/manifest.jsonl, highest ok take per line): whole clip length + 0.25 s after each line, plus the beat silence the shot carries; split parts at the midpoint of the measured pause (silencedetect -40 dB, 0.15 s). Other voiced shots are shifted by (clarity take - previous take) for each re-voiced line. Planned only: the build times voiced shots from speech.

longest_setup.rule: No set-up held past 8 s on measured clip lengths (D-018 storyboards). Every shot is under 8 s in both languages; no insert split was needed.

scenes.anchor_reason: The first frame of the scene that shows the lead well (D-013 rule 2): the palms-up two-shot that sets where Kiran and Aditya sit for the rest of the episode, both cuffs at rest (P02), the phone on the sheet, and the stool, tray, tumbler and open fold. s01 comes before it in story order but is generated after it and attaches it, as s1e01 did with its s04. b10 and b13 follow the lane cutaway inside the same continuous minutes, so they keep the same anchor.
scenes.style_frame_on: s02 only. Its plate is bedroom_bed, which is also the style frame, so the file is attached once with both labels (D-021 decision 3).

scenes.anchor_reason: Billu is the only face in the lane; s27 is his close at the bonnet. Generated first in the scene with the style frame (bedroom_bed, labelled rendering-only); s26, s29 and s35 attach it.

generation_gates: D-015 rule 7: generate the two anchors (s02, s27) first, run the anchor check, then the other 26. Every bedroom frame attaches frames/s02.png and every lane frame after s27 attaches frames/s27.png.

Frame-on-frame dependencies (the order above respects them): s04 attaches s03; s14 and s25 attach s07; s20 attaches s08; s38 attaches s25; s36 attaches s21; s37 attaches s33; s35 attaches s26; s01 attaches s1e01's approved s20. A rejected frame holds its dependants until its one retake has run (D-023 rule 4.1).

The s02 anchor attaches pair_kiran_aditya_p1 and shows Kiran's palms, not the backs of her hands; s03, s13 and s22 attach kiran_hands. s1e01 used both sheets and S9 approved those frames. The line runs across the bed, window to almirah, and every camera stays on the foot (door) side of it. So Aditya is always picture-left facing right and Kiran always picture-right facing left, as in s1e01 s20.

field_notes.duration_s: Longer language, this shot (max of duration_hi_s and duration_en_s).
field_notes.silent_lead_s: Seconds of the shot before its first line starts (a beat silence 'before', or the added s33 hold).
field_notes.camera_move: Maps to Move in production/remotion/src/types.ts. For 'custom', from/to are CameraKey {scale, x, y}: x positive looks further left, y positive looks further up (camera.ts). Every second framing keeps scale at or under 1.3 (D-010).
field_notes.refs: Absolute paths, at most five, in the order the prompt labels them: people (pair or single sheet, hand sheet), plate (or an approved frame standing in for it), prop sheets, then the scene anchor or, on an anchor, the style frame (D-013 rule 1, D-017 amendment 3, D-021 decision 3).
field_notes.subtitle_safe: true = faces, hands that matter and the key object are written above the bottom fifth of the frame.

storyboard_notes: 38 shots for 11 beats: every script set-up is one shot, in script order; nothing merged, nothing added. b4 set-up 7 and b13 set-ups 2 and 3 carry the beat silences as written.

Staging choice the script leaves open: Kiran SITS on the window-side edge of the bed with the stool beside her knees, and Aditya sits on the sheet facing her, so that 'hands out over the white sheet', 'holds it flat on the sheet', 'setting it back on the tray' and both 'low two-shots across the stool' work from one geography.

The print in b2 (s03, s04) lies face up beside her arm but out of focus and unreadable. style.json key_props.photograph says every insert in which the print's content can be read uses refs/photograph.png and is never regenerated; a defocused print keeps the comparison the beat wants without generating the content. If the cut wants the content read, the editor can lay refs/photograph.png over that area; that is an edit decision.

Departures to stay inside 28 frames: (1) s15 (b5 set-up 2) reuses s21, the b6 low two-shot across the stool, one beat early; the script asks for 'the steel glass on the tray between them', which s21 has. (2) s28 (the boys from behind) is a push on the s26 wide, which places the boys large in its foreground; D-023 rule 4.8 concerns closes, and this is not a close of a face. (3) s30 (the phone lights) reuses the s11 phone insert with new overlays. If any reads wrong in the cut, s28 gets the first spare frame.
Added 0.6 s hold before l29 on s33 so 'a second too long' can read; the editor may cut it.
Lane light follows style.json (cool blue-white streetlight), not the script's 'sodium'; the prompts follow light_states.lane_night, as s1e01 did.
Readable text is overlay only (1:52, No network, network, 2:00, caller name). Phone screens are plain glows.
Never more than two sheet faces in a frame (D-021 decision 8). Mausi is voice only. The boys are shapes with no faces, written from their shape_lock.
Lines on faces (stills cannot lip-sync): l03 (s05), l05 (s07), l12 (s14), l17 (s19), l20 (s23) for Kiran; l14, l16, l18, l21-l22 for Aditya. Those frames ask for a closed or barely parted mouth.
P01 and P02 are carried: P02 by s01 (right cuff out of frame) and s02 (both cuffs at rest); P01 by s36, s37 (dabba in his hand by the chair to the last frame).
not_verified: No frame has been generated; this file and the 28 prompts are the storyboard only. The anchor check, frame check and retake check are later steps.

I parsed this file and checked by script that every generated shot has at most 5 refs, that every non-frame ref exists, that each prompt labels exactly as many images as it attaches, that no shot runs over 8 s, that every second framing stays at or under scale 1.3, that no frame has more than two faces, and that all 29 lines are placed (l28 and l29 split across two shots each). I did not run the toolsmith's build_timeline on it.
Clip lengths are the manifest/review duration_s values; I did not re-probe the mp3s. The en l28 split point (2.23 s) is an estimate by text length; the review found no pause there.

I viewed bedroom_bed, bedroom_window, bedroom_door, lane_night, pair_kiran_aditya_p1, kiran_hands, chooda and s1e01 s20 whole at 1125x2000. I did not open kiran_p1, aditya, billu, kiran_phone, maroon_bag, glass_and_fold, key_thread, padlock_hasp, billu_car or photograph; their wording follows their sheet prompts and the rewritten locks in style.json.
Whether Codex holds the seated staging (her on the bed edge, him on the sheet) across the two-shots, the defocused print, and the scale of the boys in s26 is untested.
The D-021 retake check report was not found; see generation_gates.
